pdbx_details:
;A new crystal form of horse heart cytochrome c that co-crystallized with nitrate and sulphate ions has been obtained. Crystallization was prepared by using the hanging-drop vapour diffusion method in Linbro plates and a reservoir contained 3.5 M ammonium sulphate, 0.6 M sodium nitrate. The droplets consisted of 1 microliter protein (30 mg/mL in water) and 1 microliter of reservoir. They were equilibrated against a 500 microliters reservoir solution at 20   C. These conditions produced well shaped red crystals after 1 month. These crystals have been soaked for 24 h in a solution consisting of 0.005 M cisplatin in 2.0 M ammonium sulphate and 0.4 M sodium nitrate. To prepare this solution, Cisplatin was first dissolved in 5 mM sodium acetate buffer at pH 5.0. , VAPOR DIFFUSION, HANGING DROP, temperature 300K
;
